an5.9:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu agāravo appatisso cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme.
an5.9:1.3: Assaddho bhikkhave bhikkhu agāravo appatisso cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.9:1.4: ahiriko bhikkhave bhikkhu agāravo appatisso cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.9:1.5: anottāpī bhikkhave bhikkhu agāravo appatisso cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.9:1.6: kusīto bhikkhave bhikkhu agāravo appatisso cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.9:1.7: duppañño bhikkhave bhikkhu agāravo appatisso cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme.
an5.9:1.8: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu agāravo appatisso cavati na ppatiṭṭhāti saddhamme. 3.
an5.9:2.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme.
an5.9:2.3: Saddho bhikkhave bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.9:2.4: hirimā bhikkhave bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.9:2.5: ottāpī bhikkhave bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.9:2.6: āraddhaviriyo bhikkhave bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme,
an5.9:2.7: paññavā bhikkhave bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme.
an5.9:2.8: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso na cavati patiṭṭhāti saddhamme ti.
